_README: First rule table for the minimum-size gate (DB/32_THREE_APP_CONSTITUTION.md §4.5, Researches/-r14 finding B3). Companion to DB/37_MINIMUM_SIZE_GATE.md — read that doc for the full reasoning; this file is the machine-readable minimums the gate (GEO-8/GEO-9, proposed) tests against. Two shapes of entry: 'envelope' content types are a fixed minimum checked as a binary fit; 'formula' content types (shelf) are evaluated live against a formula, span and declared load — there is no static minimum_mm for those.
status: NEW — no prior version of this table existed. Drafted from directly viewing catalog page renders (not from the browse-grade accessory JSON, which carries no numeric tables).

validation_profile._README: Used ONLY at publish-gate time (DB/37 §4/§5), never as a per-project default. A Component with no fit_constraint badge passed the gate at this profile.
validation_profile.rationale: Worst plausible board (18mm) + R14 finding B2's laminate rule (layers × profile_thickness) + no credit for material grooves/kromka ever removing wall, never adding it. Deliberately NOT the DB/25 census default (16mm, Qorasu-specific) — see DB/37 §4 for why the census must not drive this number.

content_types.placeholder_source_note: No GTV-published minimum height found. Placeholder borrows the lowest cross-brand cited class (LEGRABOX N, 80mm) as a conservative floor — NOT a citation, an engineering assumption. This is CORE_DOCTRINE.md's F7 default and the market's actual dominant practice per DB/22 (Ulugbek) and DB/25 (46% of census panels are drawer parts, i.e. shop-built wooden boxes, not integrated steel systems) — so this gap matters more than any cited row above.

content_types.placeholder_source_note: General furniture-ergonomics convention (~20mm finger-pull recess) commonly cited in the trade; no document in this repo's catalog covers it. Needs its own short research pass.

content_types.note: Structurally different from the other envelope rows — this checks the swing arc against the NEIGHBORING Space/room geometry, not the door's own Space. Closer to DB/20 GEO-5 (fronts cover openings) than to a size minimum. The catalog already carries opening-angle-specific hinge SKUs (gtv_hinge_45_90, gtv_hinge_165, gtv_hinge_glass) implying per-SKU swing-arc data exists in source PDFs but has not been extracted into a clearance table.

content_types.warn_not_block_rationale: Deflection is continuous and load-dependent, unlike the binary envelope checks above. Matches DB/32 §4.5's own instruction to warn/block 'the same way' the existing прогиб (excess-span) amber warning already does — that precedent is WARN, not BLOCK.

formula.boundary_condition_rationale: Shelf on Ø5 pins or in an unglued groove — matches this system's construction (shelf_pin.rules.json; DB/25 F3 groove is universal but not glued to the shelf itself).
formula.I_note: h = shelf thickness (actual, not nominal), b = shelf depth (front-to-back)
formula.creep_note: Apply as 1.5 * delta_elastic <= L/240 for the long-term check, not the instantaneous value alone.

material_constants.ldsp_p2_E_source: EN 312:2010 bending-MOE table, thickness band >13-20mm; corroborated independently by EGGER Eurospan E1 P2 and Kronospan Trading P2 technical datasheets (both publish 1600 N/mm2 for the same band)
material_constants.mdf_E_source: Kronospan MDF and MEDITE MR technical datasheets, EN 310 bending-MOE, 12-19mm band; EN minimum floor 2200 N/mm2, better grades reach >=2700 N/mm2 per a cited DoP
material_constants.default_shelf_thickness_source: DB/25_NUANCE_CENSUS_FINDINGS.md F1 — 9/9 census shelf panels are 16mm, 0/359 total panels are 18mm. Qorasu-specific default, NOT the validation-profile thickness (see validation_profile block above).

severity_tier_mapping._README: Proposed additions to DB/20_ENGINE_INVARIANTS.md §2 GEO tier — proposed in DB/37 §3, not applied to that legislation doc here.
severity_tier_mapping.GEO-8: Minimum content envelope — no Space's derived interior dimensions fall below the cited minimum for its declared content type, at the profile in force at the check. Covers all 'envelope' shape rows above.
severity_tier_mapping.GEO-9: External clearance (swing/reach) — a door/drawer-front's swing arc or hand-clearance zone does not intersect neighboring built geometry. Covers 'external_clearance' shape rows above.
severity_tier_mapping.shelf_span: No new GEO id — stays on the existing прогиб (excess-span) warning mechanism, extended to the shrink direction.

engine_notes: This table assumes Researches/-r14 finding B2 (laminate thickness = layers × profile_thickness) is fixed before any of these numbers are wired into extentAlong() or its successor — otherwise every nested-child fit check inherits B2's known bug. Cross-brand equivalence (Blum vs Hettich N/M/K-style classes) is NOT assumed; Hettich AvanTech YOU / InnoTech Atira were not independently measured this pass. Do not promote verified:true on any row until: (1) the GTV VERSALITE H45 page-citation discrepancy is corrected and the actual minimum re-checked, (2) the wardrobe-rail page discrepancy is corrected, (3) hand-clearance and door-swing rows get their own citations, (4) the declared_load_q founder decision is made.
